observations: A single motorcycle tyre is shown in a close-up.
The tread pattern consists of a central block with a diamond-shaped cross-section and a series of small circular holes.
A hand is holding the tyre to demonstrate its size.
The background consists of a tiled floor, suggesting an outdoor or garage setting.
A watermark 'CENOCAUTOS' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.claim: Tread is still 90 percent, no patch, no bulge. Removed from a 2023 car.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The tyre may be a different size or brand from the buyer's intended vehicle.
risks.proof: A photo of the sidewall showing the size (e.g., 120/70-14) and the brand name.
risks.if_unproven: as the smallest standard size for a scooter

risks.risk: The rubber may be brittle, dry, or have internal damage not visible to the eye.
risks.proof: A video of the tyre being inflated and rolled on a hard surface.
risks.if_unproven: as having a high risk of blowouts

risks.risk: The tyre may be a used item from a different vehicle, which is a common scam.
risks.proof: A photo of the tyre with a handwritten note showing the date it was last used.

proof_requests: Photo of the sidewall showing the size and brand.
Video of the tyre inflated and rolling on a hard surface.
Photo of the tyre with a handwritten note showing the date it was last used.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
